papers.title_en: SlimWise: Decoupling Expert Pruning Across Prefill and Decode for Efficient MoE Serving
papers.authors: Gunho Park, Kyoungho Jeun, Juntaek Oh, Byeongjun Shin, Baeseong Park, Minsoo Rhu
papers.evidence: 面向高效MoE服务，在预填充与解码阶段解耦专家剪枝
papers.tldr: MoE 批量解码会触达近全部专家，专家权重流量成为服务瓶颈；但常规专家剪枝会误剪计算受限的 prefill，几乎不增益吞吐还损伤精度。SlimWise 解耦两阶段：prefill 用完整模型，decode 用剪枝模型并直接复用 prefill 生成的 KV cache，无需转换。它在两个 MoE 主干和三种剪枝准则上缩小精度差距，并引入低成本蒸馏，仅更新少量参数让解码器接续完整模型 KV cache。vLLM 实现支持 PD 分离与共置，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 50% 专家剪枝下解码吞吐最高提升 1.81 倍，精度损失极小。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate few experts per token, yet batched decoding can access nearly the entire expert pool, making expert-weight traffic a major bottleneck. Expert pruning reduces this traffic, but conventional approaches also prune compute-bound prefill, sacrificing model quality for little throughput benefit. We present SlimWise, a serving framework that tailors the expert pool to each inference phase. SlimWise performs prefill with the full model and decode with a pruned model that directly reuses the prefill-generated KV cache without conversion. Across two MoE backbones and three pruning criteria, this training-free KV cache handoff substantially narrows accuracy gaps relative to the full model in many settings. We also show that benchmark accuracy can conceal substantial pruning-induced changes in generation length. To address these distortions and residual accuracy loss, SlimWise introduces a low-cost distillation stage that trains the decoder to continue from full-model KV caches while updating only a small subset of parameters. Implemented in vLLM, SlimWise supports both prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation and PD-colocated serving. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, SlimWise improves decode throughput by up to 1.81x at 50% expert pruning with minimal accuracy loss.

papers.title_en: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
papers.authors: Rongyu Zhang, Ruizhi Fan, Yunfan Lou, Hengyu Fang, Shenli Zheng, Chenrui Wu, Yili Jin, Li Du, Dan Wang, Yuan Du, Shanghang Zhang
papers.evidence: 联邦聚合中的MoE式路由与专家专业化稀释问题
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作与世界动作模型受限于稀缺、机构孤立且任务异构的物理交互数据，联邦学习虽可避免交换全模型更新，但朴素聚合适配器易纠缠不兼容更新，引入 MoE 路由又可能削弱专家特化。RoboFL 为此提出 MoSAIC，将各客户端本地训练的 LoRA 适配器直接装配为服务器 MoE 的专家分支，并由服务器路由器学习令牌分配，同时用 FARD 对齐三条路径的路由、用 PCEA 把完整专家更新压缩为全局适配器再个性化分发。在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 和真实 Franka 机械臂上，RoboFL 相比集中式 PEFT InternVLA-A1 在 Franka 上提升 12.23%，客户端每轮通信最多减少 86.81%。该工作以结构化专家装配推进了联邦世界动作模型，兼顾性能与通信效率。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.
